description: This file contains functions for translating MAC layer PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) configurations into FAPI (FAPI is a standardized interface for 5G NR) PDU builder commands. It includes functions for filling in codeword, DMRS, frequency, timing, power, and coreset parameters, as well as multiple overloads for converting different MAC PDU types into FAPI format.

methods.name: get_crb_interval
methods.description: Determines the CRB interval based on the coreset configuration or bandwidth part configuration.

methods.name: fill_codewords
methods.description: Fills codeword parameters into the FAPI PDU builder, supporting only one codeword.

methods.name: fill_codeword_information
methods.description: Sets codeword identification and reference point information.

methods.name: fill_dmrs
methods.description: Fills DMRS (Demodulation Reference Signal) parameters into the PDU.

methods.name: fill_frequency_allocation
methods.description: Sets frequency resource block allocation in the PDU based on resource block group bitmap or interval.

methods.name: fill_time_allocation
methods.description: Sets time resource allocation in the PDU.

methods.name: fill_precoding_and_beamforming
methods.description: Configures precoding and beamforming parameters, including PMI mapping.

methods.name: fill_pdsch_information
methods.description: Fills basic PDSCH parameters including codewords, DMRS, time, and power info.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Configures coreset parameters based on transmission type and configuration.

methods.name: get_pdsch_trans_type
methods.description: Determines the PDSCH transmission type based on coreset ID, search space, interleaving, DCI format, and configuration.

methods.name: get_vrb_to_prb_mapping_type
methods.description: Maps internal VRB to PRB mapping types to FAPI enumeration.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Overloaded functions that convert various MAC PDSCH configurations into FAPI PDU builder commands, filling in all necessary parameters for transmission.
